name: CacheBuddy
description: Manually save a page or linked site pages and reopen them when their original URLs fail offline.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; media-src data:; font-src data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
